name: Ihara Saikaku
contribution: A Japanese poet and creator of the "floating world" genre of Japanese prose.

checks.lead: Ihara Saikaku (井原 西鶴; Japanese pronunciation: [í.bä̀.ɾä̀ | ꜜsä́ì.kä̀.kɯ̈̀, ì.bä́.ɾä́ sä́ì-]; 1642 – September 9, 1693)) was a Japanese poet and creator of the "floating world" genre of Japanese prose (ukiyo-zōshi).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
